subjects: the project's own artifact or interface, not abstract technology
composition: warm cream ground with a single saturated accent
text_policy: narrative raster assets carry one short title plus one short subtitle; icons, SVGs, logos, and tiny helper graphics remain text-free
reject_when: the image is a generic stock-technology collage with no project artifact
neon-on-black cyberpunk styling that contradicts the warm cream palette
more than one accent colour competes for attention
text is baked into an icon, logo, or helper graphic
